messages:
Alice Chen: quick sync — we need to lock the quickstarts that will act as the canonical docs-as-spec for the Q2 launch. main asks: acceptance criteria, minimal runnable examples, and launch gating criteria.

Mateo Ruiz: do we have an agreed minimal surface? I suggest 3 quickstarts: hosted text-gen, embeddings, private (VPC) deploy with KMS. keep each <10min to run.

Priya Nair: +1 to the 3. also we should include a tiny sample app (node) that uses streaming and shows token breakdown in console. reuse parts of the onboarding sample to save time. link: https://git.redwood/sample-onboard (draft)

Jordan Lee: I'll draft the examples. proposed acceptance criteria per quickstart: 1) runnable end-to-end with only free credits and default config, 2) contains a one-line verification (curl or node) that returns expected shape, 3) includes an edgecases section (rate-limit, partial failures), 4) has a one-paragraph explanation of performance tradeoffs.

Samir Patel: for private quickstart we also need an infra checklist: VPC peering steps, KMS snippet, firewall rules, and a minimal terraform example. owners?

Alice Chen: owners: Jordan -> examples + README, Mateo -> private infra snippets + verify terraform, Priya -> sample app + devex howto. Samir will review infra checklist. Milestone: draft by Thu EOD, final PR by next Tue.

Mateo Ruiz: tiny example for the verification step (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"Hello"}'
```
Response check: should return JSON with keys ["id","outputs","meta"] and outputs[0].text non-empty.

Jordan Lee: edge-case note: document expected failure modes, e.g. token-limit error, cold-start latency >500ms for private cold pools, and fallback behavior when model variant isn't available. we'll include a tiny test harness that asserts on 200 + outputs[0].text length > 0.

Priya Nair: quick wins: add a "smoke" route in the sample app that runs the verification curl automatically on first run and prints a short troubleshooting checklist if it fails.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: docs-examples/quickstarts v0.1 -> staging at 1769123475 :rocket:

Alice Chen: sounds good. last check — launch gating: QA run of the three quickstarts on staging, docs review + one external customer (beta) to sanity-check private deploy steps. if both pass -> mark as green for launch. @Jordan @Mateo @Priya pls confirm blockers asap. :thumbsup:

Mateo Ruiz: no blockers from infra side, will push terraform snippet tonight.

Jordan Lee: drafting now, will post PR link in thread when ready.

Priya Nair: sample app PR incoming in ~3 hours.

Alice Chen: thanks — we’ll reconvene if anything slips.
